rows.label: tlk44400084_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Just when it got easier to find
good food, now a war breaks out?

rows.label: tlk44400084_03_msg0002
rows.name:
My daughter's worried... I thought
warming up might calm her down.
How about you?

rows.label: tlk44400084_03_msg0003
rows.name:
The water here is heated
internally, from within the
Divine Beast, so it's always warm.

rows.label: tlk44400084_03_msg0004
rows.name:
It circulates throughout the capital,
so any snow in the city melts right
away.
